The '''LCS 2020 Spring Split''' was the first split of the third year of franchised play in the [[League of Legends Championship Series]] (LCS), organized by Riot Games. It took place from January 25 to April 19, 2020, with both the Regular Season and Playoffs held in Los Angeles, United States. Ten partner teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo1}} Regular Season, followed by a Double Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoff bracket. The total prize pool was $200,000 USD, and the split champion qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|2020 Mid-Season Invitational]].

This split marked the return of [[Immortals]] to the LCS after acquiring [[OpTic Gaming]]’s franchise slot, the debut of [[Evil Geniuses]] following their acquisition of [[Echo Fox]]’s spot, and the rebranding of [[Clutch Gaming]] into [[Dignitas]]. The event was played on Patch 10.6, with some matches transitioning to an online format due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
**Double Round Robin
**Each team plays 18 matches.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**Top 6 qualifies to the Summer Playoffs
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st till 4th place''}} advance to the Upper-bracket of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to the Lower-bracket of Playoffs.
* '''Playoffs'''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2020|Mid-Season Invitational 2020]]
